name: Past Aoi
source:
Aoi's previous incarnation, who made a contract with Futaba's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]He was in love with the past Futaba, but was rejected in favor of Kouga's previous incarnation. This love carried over into his next lifetime as Aoi.[/spoiler]
